Haa Meem
Ain Seen Qaaf
Isi tarah Khuda-e-Azeez o Hakeem aap ki taraf aur aap se pehle waalon ki taraf wahi bhejta rehta hai
Zameen o aasmaan mein jo kuch bhi hai sab usi ki milkiyat hai, aur wahi Khuda-e-Buzurg o Bartar hai

Qareeb hai ke aasmaan us ki haibat se oopar se shigaafta ho jaayein, aur malaaika bhi apne Parwardigar ki hamd ki tasbeeh kar rahe hain aur zameen waalon ke haq mein istighfaar kar rahe hain. Aagaah ho jaao ke Khuda hi woh hai jo bahut bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Aur jin logon ne us ke ilaawa sarparast bana liye hain Allah un sab ke haalaat ka nigraan hai, aur Paighambar! Aap kisi ke zimmedaar nahin hain

Aur hum ne isi tarah aap ki taraf Arabi zabaan mein Quran ki wahi bheji taake aap Makka aur us ke atraaf waalon ko daraayein, aur us din se daraayein jis din sab ko jama kiya jaaega aur us mein kisi shak ki gunjaaish nahin hai. Us din ek giroh Jannat mein hoga aur ek Jahannam mein hoga
Aur agar Khuda chaahta to sab ko ek qaum bana deta, lekin woh jise chaahta hai usi ko apni rehmat mein daakhil karta hai, aur zaalimeen ke liye na koi sarparast hai aur na madadgaar
Kya un logon ne us ko chhod kar apne liye sarparast banaaye hain, jab ke wahi sab ka sarparast hai aur wahi murdon ko zinda karta hai, aur woh har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai
Aur tum jis cheez mein bhi ikhtilaaf karoge us ka faisla Allah ke haathon mein hai. Wahi mera Parwardigar hai aur usi par mera bharosa hai aur usi ki taraf main rujoo karta hoon

Woh aasmaanon aur zameen ka paida karne waala hai. Us ne tumhaare nufoos mein se bhi joda banaaya hai aur jaanwaron mein se bhi jode banaaye hain, woh tum ko isi jode ke zariye duniya mein phaila raha hai. Us ka jaisa koi nahin hai, woh sab ki sunne waala aur har cheez ka dekhne waala hai

Aasmaan o zameen ki tamaam kunjiyaan usi ke ikhtiyaar mein hain. Woh jis ke liye chaahta hai us ke rizq mein wus'at paida kar deta hai aur jis ke liye chaahta hai tangi paida kar deta hai, woh har shai ka khoob jaanne waala hai

Us ne tumhaare liye deen mein woh raasta muqarrar kiya hai jis ki naseehat Nooh ko ki hai, aur Paighambar! Jis ki wahi tumhaari taraf bhi ki hai, aur jis ki naseehat Ibraheem alaihis-salaam, Moosa alaihis-salaam aur Eesa alaihis-salaam ko bhi ki hai, ke deen ko qaaim karo aur us mein tafriqa na paida hone paaye. Mushrikeen ko woh baat sakht giraan guzarti hai jis ki tum inhein daawat de rahe ho. Allah jis ko chaahta hai apni baargaah ke liye chun leta hai, aur jo us ki taraf rujoo karta hai use hidaayat de deta hai

Aur un logon ne aapas mein tafriqa usi waqt paida kiya hai jab un ke paas ilm aa chuka tha, aur yeh sirf aapas ki dushmani ki bina par tha. Aur agar Parwardigar ki taraf se ek baat pehle se ek muddat ke liye tai na ho gayi hoti to ab tak un ke darmiyaan faisla ho chuka hota, aur beshak jin logon ko un ke baad kitaab ka waaris banaaya gaya hai woh us ki taraf se sakht shak mein pade hue hain

Lihaaza aap usi ke liye daawat dein aur is tarah istiqaamat se kaam lein jis tarah aap ko hukm diya gaya hai, aur un ki khwaahishaat ka ittibaa' na karein, aur yeh kahein ke mera imaan us kitaab par hai jo Khuda ne naazil ki hai, aur mujhe hukm diya gaya hai ke tumhaare darmiyaan insaaf karoon. Allah hamaara aur tumhaara dono ka Parwardigar hai, hamaare aamaal hamaare liye hain aur tumhaare aamaal tumhaare liye. Hamaare aur tumhaare darmiyaan koi behas nahin hai, Allah hum sab ko ek din jama karega aur usi ki taraf sab ki baazgasht hai
Aur jo log us ke maan liye jaane ke baad Khuda ke baare mein jhagda karte hain un ki daleel bilkul muhmal aur laghw hai, aur un par Allah ka ghazab hai aur un ke liye shadeed qism ka azaab hai
Allah hi woh hai jis ne haq ke saath kitaab aur meezaan ko naazil kiya hai, aur aap ko kya maaloom ke shaayad qiyaamat qareeb hi ho

Us ki jaldi sirf woh log karte hain jin ka us par imaan nahin hai, warna jo imaan waale hain woh to us se khaufzada hi rehte hain aur yeh jaante hain ke woh bahar-haal barhaq hai. Hoshyaar! Ke jo log qiyaamat ke baare mein shak karte hain woh gumraahi mein bahut door tak chale gaye hain
Allah apne bandon par meharbaan hai, woh jis ko bhi chaahta hai rizq ata karta hai, aur woh saahib-e-quwwat bhi hai aur saahib-e-izzat bhi hai

Jo insaan aakhirat ki khaiti chaahta hai hum us ke liye izaafa kar dete hain, aur jo duniya ki khaiti ka talabgaar hai use usi mein se ata kar dete hain, aur phir aakhirat mein us ka koi hissa nahin hai

Kya un ke liye aise shuraka bhi hain jinhon ne deen ke woh raaste muqarrar kiye hain jin ki Khuda ne ijaazat bhi nahin di hai? Aur agar faisle ke din ka waada na ho gaya hota to ab tak un ke darmiyaan faisla kar diya gaya hota, aur yaqeenan zaalimon ke liye bada dardnaak azaab hai

Aap dekhenge ke zaalimeen apne kartoot ke azaab se khaufzada hain aur woh un par bahar-haal naazil hone waala hai. Aur jo log imaan le aaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye hain woh Jannat ke baaghaat mein rahenge, aur un ke liye Parwardigar ki baargaah mein woh tamaam cheezein hain jin ke woh khwaahishmand honge, aur yeh ek bahut bada fazl-e-Parwardigar hai

Yahi woh fazl-e-azeem hai jis ki bashaarat Parwardigar apne bandon ko deta hai jinhon ne imaan ikhtiyaar kiya hai aur nek aamaal kiye hain. To aap keh dijiye ke main tum se is tableegh-e-risaalat ka koi ajr nahin chaahta, ilaawa is ke ke mere aqraba se mohabbat karo. Aur jo shakhs bhi koi neki haasil karega hum us ki neki mein izaafa kar denge, ke beshak Allah bahut zyaada bakhshne waala aur qadr-daan hai

Kya un logon ka kehna yeh hai ke Rasool Allah par jhoote bohtaan baandhta hai? Jab ke Khuda chaahe to tumhaare qalb par bhi mohr laga sakta hai, aur Khuda to baatil ko mita deta hai aur haq ko apne kalimaat ke zariye saabit aur paaedaar bana deta hai, yaqeenan woh dilon ke raazon ka jaanne waala hai
Aur wahi woh hai jo apne bandon ki tauba ko qubool karta hai aur un ki buraaiyon ko maaf karta hai, aur woh tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai

Aur jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye wahi daawat-e-Ilaahi ko qubool karte hain, aur Khuda apne fazl o karam se un ke ajr mein izaafa kar deta hai, aur kaafireen ke liye to bada sakht azaab rakha gaya hai

Aur agar Khuda tamaam bandon ke liye rizq ko wasee' kar deta to yeh log zameen mein baghaawat kar dete, magar woh apni mashiyyat ke mutaabiq mu'ayyana miqdaar mein naazil karta hai, ke woh apne bandon se khoob baakhabar hai aur un ke haalaat ka dekhne waala hai
Wahi woh hai jo un ke maayoos ho jaane ke baad baarish ko naazil karta hai aur apni rehmat ko muntashir karta hai, aur wahi qaabil-e-taareef maalik aur sarparast hai
Aur us ki nishaaniyon mein se zameen o aasmaan ki khilqat aur un ke andar chalne waale tamaam jaandaar hain, aur woh jab chaahe un sab ko jama kar lene par qudrat rakhne waala hai
Aur tum tak jo museebat bhi pahunchti hai woh tumhaare haathon ki kamaai hai, aur woh bahut si baaton ko maaf bhi kar deta hai
Aur tum zameen mein Khuda ko aajiz nahin kar sakte ho, aur tumhaare liye us ke ilaawa koi sarparast aur madadgaar bhi nahin hai
Aur us ki nishaaniyon mein se samandar mein chalne waale baadbaani jahaaz bhi hain jo pahaad ki tarah buland hain
Woh agar chaahe to hawa ko saakin bana de to sab satah-e-aab par jam kar reh jaayein. Beshak is haqeeqat mein sabr o shukr karne waalon ke liye bahut si nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain
Ya woh inhein un ke aamaal ki bina par halaak hi kar de, aur woh bahut si baaton ko maaf bhi kar deta hai
Aur hamaari aayaton mein jhagda karne waalon ko maaloom ho jaana chaahiye ke un ke liye koi chhutkaara nahin hai

Pas tum ko jo kuch bhi diya gaya hai woh zindagaani-e-duniya ka chain hai aur bas, aur jo kuch Allah ki baargaah mein hai woh khair aur baaqi rehne waala hai un logon ke liye jo imaan rakhte hain aur apne Parwardigar par bharosa karte hain
Aur bade bade gunaahon aur fahsh baaton se parhez karte hain, aur jab ghussa aa jaata hai to maaf kar dete hain
Aur jo apne Rab ki baat ko qubool karte hain aur namaaz qaaim karte hain, aur aapas ke mu'aamlaat mein mashwara karte hain, aur hamaare rizq mein se hamaari raah mein kharch karte hain
Aur jab un par koi zulm hota hai to us ka badla le lete hain
Aur har buraai ka badla us ke jaisa hota hai, phir jo maaf kar de aur islaah kar de us ka ajr Allah ke zimme hai, woh yaqeenan zaalimon ko dost nahin rakhta hai
Aur jo shakhs bhi zulm ke baad badla le us ke oopar koi ilzaam nahin hai
Ilzaam un logon par hai jo logon par zulm karte hain aur zameen mein na-haq zyaadatiyaan phailaate hain, unhi logon ke liye dardnaak azaab hai
Aur yaqeenan jo sabr kare aur maaf kar de to us ka yeh amal bade hausle ka kaam hai

Aur jis ko Khuda gumraahi mein chhod de us ke liye us ke baad koi wali aur sarparast nahin hai, aur tum dekhoge ke zaalimeen azaab ko dekhne ke baad yeh kahenge ke kya waapasi ka koi raasta nikal sakta hai

Aur tum inhein dekhoge ke woh Jahannam ke saamne pesh kiye jaayenge to zillat se un ke sar jhuke hue honge aur woh kan-ankhiyon se dekhte bhi jaayenge. Aur saahibaan-e-imaan kahenge ke ghaate waale wahi afraad hain jinhon ne apne nafs aur apne ahl ko qiyaamat ke din ghaate mein mubtala kar diya hai. Aagaah ho jaao ke zaalimon ko bahar-haal daaimi azaab mein rehna padega
Aur un ke liye aise sarparast bhi na honge jo Khuda se hat kar un ki madad kar sakein, aur jis ko Khuda gumraahi mein chhod de us ke liye koi raasta nahin hai

Tum log apne Parwardigar ki baat ko qubool karo qabl is ke ke woh din aa jaaye jo palatne waala nahin hai. Us din tumhaare liye koi panaah-gaah bhi na hogi aur azaab ka inkaar karne ki himmat bhi na hogi

Ab bhi agar yeh log e'teraaz karein to hum ne aap ko un ka nigehbaan bana kar nahin bheja hai, aap ka farz sirf paighaam pahuncha dena tha aur bas. Aur hum jab kisi insaan ko rehmat ka maza chakhaate hain to woh akad jaata hai, aur jab us ke aamaal hi ke nateeje mein koi buraai pahunch jaati hai to bahut zyaada naashukri karne waala ban jaata hai
Beshak aasmaan o zameen ka ikhtiyaar sirf Allah ke haathon mein hai. Woh jo kuch chaahta hai paida karta hai, jis ko chaahta hai betiyaan ata karta hai aur jis ko chaahta hai bete ata karta hai
Ya phir bete aur betiyaan dono ko jama kar deta hai, aur jis ko chaahta hai baanjh hi bana deta hai. Yaqeenan woh saahib-e-ilm bhi hai aur saahib-e-qudrat o ikhtiyaar bhi hai

Aur kisi insaan ke liye yeh baat nahin hai ke Allah us se kalaam kare magar yeh ke wahi kar de, ya pas-e-parda se baat kar le, ya koi numaainda farishta bhej de, aur phir woh us ki ijaazat se jo woh chaahta hai woh paighaam pahuncha de, ke woh yaqeenan buland o baala aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Aur isi tarah hum ne aap ki taraf apne hukm se rooh (Quran) ki wahi ki hai. Aap ko nahin maaloom tha ke kitaab kya hai aur imaan kin cheezon ka naam hai, lekin hum ne ise ek noor qaraar diya hai jis ke zariye apne bandon mein jise chaahte hain use hidaayat de dete hain, aur beshak aap logon ko seedhe raaste ki hidaayat kar rahe hain
Us Khuda ka raasta jis ke ikhtiyaar mein zameen o aasmaan ki tamaam cheezein hain, aur yaqeenan usi ki taraf tamaam umoor ki baazgasht hai
